name: Wants, Fears and Aspirations
author: Simitone
description: The Sims 2's aspirations: each Sim has an aspiration, four wants and three fears, and a meter from Aspiration Failure to Platinum. Fulfilled wants earn points to spend on rewards, which are effects rather than objects. A first stage, not yet run against a game: back up your saves first. F7 or Options > Aspiration; type aspire help in the console.
